summary: Which of the hero-synergy names are free on npm, VS Code Marketplace, and Open VSX, and what are the registry rules for claiming them?

resolution.gist: The npm organization @hero-synergy and scoped packages are owned by Eduardo; the unscoped hero-synergy name is free; Marketplace and Open VSX publisher IDs hero-synergy and dbarjs are likely free; Marketplace publisher IDs are immutable once created; Open VSX namespace claims require human review and the Marketplace publisher must exist first.
